
# UI Pirate — SaaS & AI Product Design & Full-Stack Development Agency
# Full AI Context Document (llms-full.txt)
# Last updated: 2026-08-21

> UI Pirate is a full-service product design and development agency founded by Vishal Anand in 2017.
> We turn product ideas into fully functional shipped products — handling everything from product thinking and
> competitive analysis to UX/UI design and end-to-end full-stack software development in Angular,
> React, Next.js, Node.js, and Python. We serve Fortune 500 companies and high-growth startups across USA, UK, Singapore,
> India, and Australia. 50+ products shipped with a 5.0 rating.

## Company Overview

**Name**: UI Pirate (also known as UI Pirate by Vishal Anand)
**Founded**: 2017
**Founder**: Vishal Anand (9+ years experience in product design & full-stack software engineering)
**Headquarters**: India (remote-first, serving clients globally)
**Rating**: 5.0 stars across Clutch, Upwork, and Google
**Projects Shipped**: 50+ products

**Core Mission**: We are NOT just a design agency that makes static screens. Our approach:
"Have a conversation about your product — we carry the rest." From a few lines of your vision,
we help you think through, plan, design, build, and ship your complete working product.

---

## Services

### 1. SaaS Web & Mobile App Design & Development
End-to-end product design and frontend development for SaaS platforms, AI tools, dashboards,
and mobile-first products. We handle product thinking, competitive analysis, information
architecture, UX/UI design, prototyping, and production-ready code in Angular, React, Next.js.
Timeline: 1-2 months.

### 2. Landing Pages & Business Websites
High-converting landing pages and corporate websites. We think through your positioning,
competitive landscape, and user journey — then design and develop in Angular, React, Next.js,
Framer, or Webflow. Timeline: 2-4 weeks.

### 3. UI Development & Frontend Engineering
Production-ready frontend development in Angular (v14+), React, and Next.js. Specializing in
complex enterprise applications — multi-role dashboards, data-heavy interfaces, API integration,
and performance optimization.

### 4. Design Systems & Component Libraries
Custom design tokens, branded UI kits, documented and dev-ready Angular/React component libraries
for scalable product teams. Timeline: 1-4 weeks.

### 5. UX Audits & Consultation
Heuristic analysis, usability testing, friction point identification, and strategic UX
recommendations for existing products.

## Pricing

UI Pirate offers multiple engagement models:
- **Pay Per Project**: Fixed-scope, fixed-price engagements for defined deliverables
- **Monthly Retainer**: Ongoing design & development partnership
- **5-Day Pilot**: A risk-free pilot project to experience working with UI Pirate before committing

Typical project ranges: Landing pages from $1,500–$5,000; SaaS products from $5,000–$25,000+.
Detailed pricing at https://uipirate.com/pricing

## Technology Stack

**Design**: Figma, Adobe XD, Framer, Webflow
**Frontend Development**: Angular (v14+), React, Next.js, TypeScript
**Styling**: Tailwind CSS, SCSS, CSS Modules
**Backend**: Node.js, MongoDB, PostgreSQL (integration support)
**CMS**: Custom CMS, Contentful, Sanity, WordPress
**Deployment**: Vercel, AWS, Cloudflare

## Case Studies & Portfolio

### Xperiti — Enterprise Research Platform (USA)
Challenge: Complex research workflow for enterprise clients; clunky legacy UI.
Solution: Full UX overhaul with role-based dashboards, advanced filtering, and streamlined
research collaboration workflows. Built in Angular.
Result: Significantly improved task completion rates and client satisfaction.
URL: https://uipirate.com/case-studies/xperiti

### LegalTech AI SaaS — APAC's Largest Law Firm (India)
Challenge: AI-powered legal platform for a top law firm with complex case management.
Solution: Designed and built an AI-driven LegalTech platform with intelligent document
processing, multi-role access, and real-time collaboration features.
URL: https://uipirate.com/case-studies/legaltech-ai-saas

### ION — Order Fulfilment SaaS Platform
Challenge: Complex B2B order fulfilment platform with multiple stakeholder roles.
Solution: End-to-end UX/UI design for a multi-role SaaS platform with real-time tracking,
analytics dashboards, and workflow automation.
URL: https://uipirate.com/case-studies/ion

### ArthAlpha — AI Trading Platform (Bangalore, India)
Challenge: AI-powered trading platform requiring complex data visualisation and real-time feeds.
Solution: Designed an intuitive trading dashboard with AI insights panels, portfolio analytics,
and real-time market data visualization.
URL: https://uipirate.com/case-studies/arthalpha

## Our Process

1. **Discovery Call** — You share your vision (even just a few lines of an idea)
2. **Competitive Analysis** — We research your market, competitors, and positioning
3. **Information Architecture** — User flows, feature prioritization, site/app structure
4. **UX Design** — Wireframes, user journey mapping, interaction design
5. **UI Design** — High-fidelity mockups, design system, brand-aligned visual design
6. **Development** — Production-ready Angular/React/Next.js code, API integration
7. **Handoff & Support** — Deployment, documentation, and ongoing retainer options

---

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What types of companies does UI Pirate work with?**
A: We work with SaaS startups, tech companies, and enterprise clients across USA, UK, Singapore, India, and Australia. Our clients range from seed-stage startups to Fortune 500 companies and include fintech, healthtech, legaltech, e-commerce, and AI companies.

**Q: How long does a typical project take?**
A: Landing pages and business websites typically take 2-4 weeks. SaaS and complex web applications take 1-2 months. We also offer ongoing monthly retainers for teams that need continuous design and development support.

**Q: Do you only design, or do you also develop?**
A: We do both. UI Pirate provides end-to-end services — from product strategy and UX design to full frontend development in Angular, React, and Next.js. We can also hand off pixel-perfect designs to your existing development team.

**Q: What makes UI Pirate different from other design agencies?**
A: Most design agencies focus only on aesthetics. We combine product thinking with design and development — helping you think through your product, plan its architecture, design the experience, and build it. We've shipped 50+ products with a 5.0 rating.

**Q: How do we get started?**
A: Book a free 15-minute call at https://cal.com/ui-pirate/15min or email vishal@uipirate.com. You can also submit a project estimate at https://uipirate.com/contact.

**Q: What is your pricing model?**
A: We offer pay-per-project, monthly retainers, and a 5-day pilot option to try us risk-free. Visit https://uipirate.com/pricing for detailed pricing.

**Q: Do you work with international clients?**
A: Yes. We serve clients primarily in USA, UK, Singapore, India, and Australia, but work with teams globally. All collaboration is remote-first using Figma, Notion, Slack, and video calls.

**Q: Can you redesign an existing product?**
A: Yes. We regularly take on redesign projects — whether it's a full UX overhaul, a UI refresh, or a targeted UX audit and consultation. We start with an audit of your existing product before designing improvements.
